# High Country Home Pros

> Construction and handyman company serving the North Carolina High Country: Boone, Blowing Rock, Banner Elk, Valle Crucis, Sugar Mountain, Beech Mountain, West Jefferson, and surrounding areas. One local crew covering every residential trade. Phone/text: (828) 201-2218. Email: Info@highcountryhomepros.com.

Three promises define the business: we return calls, we show up on time, and we finish every job. Pricing is hourly or by the job; on many projects customers buy materials and pay for labor, with a materials list provided up front.

## Services

- Roofing (shingle replacement, metal upgrades, repairs, drone roof inspections): https://highcountryhomepros.com/roofing.html
- Carpentry & framing (rough-in framing to finish trim): https://highcountryhomepros.com/carpentry-framing.html
- Drywall hanging, finishing & painting (20+ years experience): https://highcountryhomepros.com/drywall-painting.html
- Decks & patios (footer to completion): https://highcountryhomepros.com/decks-patios.html
- Log cabin repair & maintenance (15+ years on log homes): https://highcountryhomepros.com/log-cabin-repair.html
- Hot tub installation, repair & water care: https://highcountryhomepros.com/hot-tub-services.html
- Tile & stone work (showers, backsplashes, floors, stone features): https://highcountryhomepros.com/tile-stone.html
- Louvered privacy enclosures for decks and hot tubs: https://highcountryhomepros.com/louvered-privacy-enclosures.html
- Geodesic dome & specialty structure construction: https://highcountryhomepros.com/domes.html
- STR (short-term rental) design & revenue optimization: https://highcountryhomepros.com/str-design.html
- Vacation-rental property care (guest-ready repairs, turnarounds, photo-documented inspections): https://highcountryhomepros.com/vacation-rental-care.html
- Water damage remediation, runoff/drainage control, culvert install/relocation: https://highcountryhomepros.com/water-damage.html
- Crawlspace encapsulation, venting & moisture remediation: https://highcountryhomepros.com/crawlspace-encapsulation.html
- Large glass & window installation
- Insulation

## Distinguishing facts

- The company builds and operates its own top-rated short-term rentals in the Blowing Rock area (a storybook castle, cabins, geodesic domes, a treepod), so rental-facing services are grounded in operator experience.
- Water management is a specialty cluster: full-service damage response (dry-out, tear-out, rebuild by one crew) plus prevention (grading, drainage, culverts, crawlspace encapsulation).
- Family-stay design features (themed bunk rooms, crawl-through play spaces) are a signature of its STR design work.
